name: pile-squat.html
instructions:
1. Select a dumbbell and position it vertically on the floor.
2. Setup with a wider than shoulder width stance stance and allow your arms to hang straight down to the floor.
3. Squat down and grab the edges of the dumbbell with both hands.
4. Keep your abs braced and drive your feet through the floor as you stand up tall.
5. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
